---
title: "Slide decks"
---

This section will collect editable RevealJS slide decks that can be taught directly or adapted for different audiences.

Each deck should include:

- source `.qmd` files rather than only a rendered presentation;
- learning outcomes and an approximate duration;
- speaker or facilitator notes where appropriate;
- attribution and licences for externally sourced material;
- links to associated exercises, datasets and modules.

Use the [slide-deck template on GitHub](https://github.com/DrMattG/Understanding_Evidence_synthesis/blob/main/templates/slides-template.qmd) as a starting point.
